Akṣaracūḍāmaṇi
jy.-tantra. Bikaner 4407-8. Bu7hler 551. Chani 1452. D. p. 60. Dacca 533. A. 636 J. IO. 6093. Kh. 118. Mithilā III. 2. PUL. II. p. 210.
As Keith points out under IO. 6093, the description of this a. a Jain Śvet. work, or a. a work on Jain dharma in [Page012-b] Bu7hler, D., an. Kh. is wrong. To this same mistake is due the entry of this title on p. 366 of the Jainagranthāvalī.
The authority for the title ‘Akṣaracūḍāmaṇi’ which Keith also adopts, is however lacking. Keith's extracts of colophons in IO. 6093 give the title of the work a. ‘Cūḍāmaṇisāra.’
In fact, this work is identical with the Cūḍāmaṇisāra, jy., by Bhaṭṭa Lakṣmaṇa, occurring in Auf. C.. II. an. III, an. from which Alwar, p. 176, gives extracts (no. 475). The text corresponds with that of IO. 6093, though the former has a different benedictory verse an. three more preliminary verses.
